plainName: Arrears of rent and unrealised rent recovered later
summary: Arrears of rent you receive from a tenant, and rent you could not realise earlier but recover later, are taxed under this head in the year you receive them, less a fixed share, whether or not you still own the house.

routes.name: Arrears or recovered rent received in the year
routes.description: Taxed in the year received, less a fixed share.
